scripts.build: echo 'Add your web build command here (e.g., vite build)'
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init 'Fast uPost' com.nadav.fastupost --web-dir dist
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
